name: Anonymous Transactional Dataset
attribution: Engel, Mychael Maoeretz; Gaol, Ford Lumban; Kurniawan, Aditya; Budiharto, Widodo (2026), Anonymous Transactional Dataset, Mendeley Data, V2, doi:10.17632/kcgf45y24m.2

report.target: Recorded item occurrences per product, outlet and source-calendar date; TotalItem reconciles list length.
report.zero_policy: After first observed product occurrence, no item on an outlet-active date is an inferred recorded-sales zero. Dates without any outlet receipts remain unknown. This does not prove stock or menu availability.
report.price_policy: Currency is not specified by the files. Static product metadata prices and basket totals are excluded from all model features; unit_price=0.
limitations: No item-level quantity field beyond item tokens and TotalItem; this target is reconciled recorded item occurrences.
No stockout, closure, cancellation or complete-day flags; recorded sales are not unconstrained demand.
Dates use the source calendar without assuming a timezone or converting them to Bangkok.
